normalized.result: Both keep all the text — nothing's thrown away, which is the important thing. But for the scannable list I want, the compact card wins. It trims the long title, description, and note down to a couple of lines so each bookmark stays a tidy, glanceable block, and "Show full note" is right there when I actually want the whole thing. The fully-expanded version turns one bookmark into a wall of text that would make a real list a chore to skim. So I'd go with the compact card.
